name: Woodlore, LLC
old_description: Located in Rockbridge County, Virginia, Woodlore LLC is an environmentally conscious business which salvages local trees that have fallen from storms and urbanization. Instead of harvesting trees, we save dead or diseased trees from being processed into non recyclable products such as firewood, and mill them into natural live edge slabs. We sell local wood and build custom furniture.  Some of our featured products include tables, desks, benches, mantels, countertops and bar tops. These custom pieces display the log’s unique spalting, feathering, ambrosia, voids, inclusions, and knots; and may artistically expose nails, bullets, barbed wire and various other articles lodged in the tree. In addition, portable sawmill services are available for clients who wish to reclaim logs from their property and create their own heirloom furniture. We also offer kiln drying services with our iDRY vacuum kiln.  Our mission is to offer new life to dead trees, and thereby provide customers with organic furnishings and artisan materials. Our philosophy is to care for the environment by crafting furniture with locally salvaged trees.  Woodlore values honesty, integrity, and quality craftsmanship.
about:
Woodlore, LLC operates from Fairfield in Rockbridge County, Virginia. The company was founded on the principle of salvaging local trees that have fallen due to storms or urbanization, rather than harvesting live timber. No founding year or founder names are publicly disclosed, and ownership structure is not specified.

The company mills salvaged logs into natural live edge slabs and fabricates custom furniture including tables, desks, benches, mantels, countertops, and bar tops. All processing—from log salvage to finishing—occurs under one roof. Woodlore also provides portable sawmill services using a Wood-Mizer LT50 Wide hydraulic sawmill, and kiln drying via an iDRY vacuum kiln with a capacity of 13 feet long by 48 inches wide by 55 inches thick (stickered lumber pile), handling up to 2,000 board feet per cycle. Drying time averages approximately one week per inch of lumber thickness. Facility size, employee count, and annual production volumes are not disclosed.

Woodlore serves residential and commercial clients seeking custom furniture and live edge slabs, as well as landowners, arborists, and the Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) for tree salvage and milling services. The company works with clients who want to reclaim logs from their own property for heirloom furniture, and collaborates with designers and builders on custom pieces.

The company’s stated mission is to give new life to dead trees, providing organic furnishings and artisan materials while caring for the environment. Woodlore emphasizes honesty, integrity, and quality craftsmanship, and differentiates itself by keeping the entire process—from salvage to finished product—in-house, allowing clients to participate in wood selection and design.

name: Woodside Industries Inc
old_description: Woodside Industries specializes in custom commercial cabinetry for medium to large projects, providing quality, style, and innovation from design to installation.
about:
Woodside Industries Inc is based in Cavalier, North Dakota. Founded in 2001, the company began with local kitchen projects before expanding into custom commercial cabinetry. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company operates a 30,000-square-foot facility where it designs, manufactures, finishes, and installs custom commercial cabinetry, architectural millwork, and industrial casework. Its capabilities include healthcare-grade cabinetry, an automated finishing line, and a range of countertop materials. Headcount and annual volume are not disclosed.

Woodside serves healthcare, multi-unit residential, education, government, hospitality, banking, dental, retail, airport, and restaurant sectors. Past clients include Langlas & Associates for school projects in Montana and North Dakota, with completed projects in Fargo, Bozeman, Grand Rapids, Grand Forks, and Ponderay.

The company emphasizes its membership in the Architectural Woodwork Institute and participation in the Quality Certification Program, along with FSC-certified product options. Its stated mission centers on precision, consistency, and teamwork, supported by values such as accuracy, fairness, and accountability.

about:
Woodwork of Vermont operates from Manchester Center, Vermont, as a family-owned business led by owner and designer Adam Cyr. The company has served the region for over two decades, growing from a local woodworking shop into a full-service kitchen and bath design studio.

The firm manufactures custom wood countertops — including butcher block, live-edge slabs, reclaimed barn board, teak, and mahogany — and provides comprehensive interior remodeling services such as kitchen and bathroom design, mudroom and laundry room build-outs, closet systems, and window and siding installation. It also supplies hardware, plumbing fixtures, lighting, and flooring from a curated selection of premium brands.

Woodwork of Vermont primarily serves residential homeowners and builders in the Green Mountains area, collaborating with cabinet lines from Fieldstone, Ultra Craft, Shiloh, Eclipse, Woodharbor, and Aspect, while specifying appliances and fixtures from Kohler, Brizo, Newport Brass, and Hubbardton Forge.

The company emphasizes personalized service, operating its showroom by appointment only to ensure each project receives dedicated design attention. Its founders cite a commitment to timeless designs that harmonize with the Vermont landscape as the driving force behind the business.

name: Woodworks Studio
old_description: Gift certificates never expire and can be used for any class. So, you don't have to worry that you are choosing the exact right class! They can sign up after the holidays and use the funds for any class they like!
about:
Woodworks Studio operates at 2555 S Santa Fe, Unit F2, in Denver, Colorado. The studio has offered woodworking instruction for over two decades, with the lead instructor teaching beginner classes for more than 20 years.

The studio provides woodworking education through beginner, intermediate, private, and intensive workshop formats. Beginner classes cover safe operation of table saws, jointers, planers, miter saws, and routers to build a small table or bookcase, including panel glue-up, basic joinery, and finishing techniques. Intermediate classes are student-directed, allowing participants to design and build projects such as jewelry boxes, butcher blocks, coffee tables, dining tables, bookshelves, and cabinets while learning advanced joinery like mortise-and-tenon and dovetails. Private classes offer guided project work for groups. Intensive week-long workshops focus on basic woodworking and cabinet building in small groups.

Classes serve hobbyists, beginners, and intermediate woodworkers seeking hands-on instruction. Customers include individuals purchasing gift certificates — which never expire and are transferable across any class — as well as those scheduling private or semi-private sessions.

The instructor emphasizes safety, noting no significant injuries in over 20 years of teaching beginner classes. The studio aims to provide quality instruction with no hidden fees for beginner classes, and flexible scheduling for intermediate classes that never expire.

name: WorkbenchRVA
old_description: The Workbench was founded to help everyone express their creativity and think outside the box. We feel children need this more than anyone else. A creative child is a happy, social and intelligent child!
about:
WorkbenchRVA operates as a public woodworking shop in Richmond, Virginia. The business was founded by Dalton, a lifelong woodworker who first discovered the craft in middle school. After working at a cabinet shop under mentor Mike Sibley, owner of Sibley's Custom Cabinetry, Dalton developed the concept for a membership-based facility while completing a college business course with guidance from Professor Dr. James Haug. The venture launched to address the loss of school woodshop programs and the lack of accessible shop space for children and adults alike.

The facility provides 24/7 access to a fully operational cabinet shop equipped with table saws, jointers, and planers. Members receive project storage, discounted lumber, and a free orientation. Beyond shop access, WorkbenchRVA offers woodworking classes, kids workshops, tool-basics sessions, and private one-on-one instruction — all open to non-members. A retail area stocks hardwoods, softwoods, exotic woods, sandpaper, and finishes. The company also accepts custom woodworking commissions for homes and businesses.

The shop serves hobbyists, beginners, weekend warriors, and families seeking creative outlets, as well as small businesses needing custom woodwork. Classes and kids programs are designed for participants without prior experience, emphasizing a welcoming, grade-free environment.

Dalton started WorkbenchRVA to give people — especially children — the space, tools, and instruction that schools no longer provide. The goal is to foster creativity and hands-on learning in a fun, supportive community setting.

name: Workshop Detroit
old_description: Workshop Detroit handcrafts solid wood furniture in Detroit from sustainably sourced reclaimed wood and steel. Choose from our best-selling designs or request a custom size, finish, or style built for your space. You can start a custom quote by following the link below. - We are happy to assist!
about:
Operating from Detroit, Michigan, Workshop Detroit is a furniture workshop led by Kevin Borsay. The company handcrafts solid wood furniture using sustainably sourced reclaimed lumber and steel, producing pieces that range from dining tables and coffee tables to butcher block countertops.

Production is made-to-order in the company's Detroit fabrication shop, with a typical lead time of approximately ten weeks. The workshop offers customization of dimensions, finishes, and styles across its product line, which includes end-grain and edge-grain butcher block tops as well as a small ready-to-ship inventory of tables, benches, and storage pieces.

The business serves residential customers directly, with testimonials from homeowners such as Jenny Sayre, Steven Stanford, and Janet Anderson highlighting the substantial feel of the furniture and the provenance stamping that marks the origin of each board. Custom quotes are also available for designers and specifiers seeking tailored pieces.

Workshop Detroit emphasizes honest materials, building exclusively with solid reclaimed wood and steel rather than veneers or particle board. The company states that this approach yields furniture with true substance, natural character, and a presence that only authentic materials can provide, and that each piece is designed to last for generations.

name: World Weidner
old_description: Bo Nash offers top-quality sewing and quilting products! This family-run company specializes in essential items for fabric repairs, basting, and embellishing.
about:
World Weidner operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, where it was founded in 2005 as a family-owned business. The company began as a specialty retailer serving the sewing and quilting community, building its reputation on personal service and deep product knowledge.

The retailer functions as an authorized dealer for major machine brands including Brother, Janome, and JUKI, while also carrying products from over 200 other manufacturers such as Bernina, Pfaff, Handi Quilter, and AccuQuilt. Its inventory spans sewing machines, embroidery machines, longarm quilting systems, sergers, fabric cutters, and sublimation printers, alongside a comprehensive selection of fabrics, threads, stabilizers, notions, patterns, and sewing furniture. The business runs both an e-commerce platform and a physical showroom, though facility size and staff numbers are not publicly disclosed.

Customers range from hobbyist sewists and quilters to small apparel shops and embroidery businesses. The product mix supports garment construction, quilting, machine embroidery, vinyl crafting, and general textile arts. Licensed fabric collections from designers like Tula Pink, Riley Blake, and Moda sit alongside technical supplies such as embroidery stabilizers, specialty needles, and machine accessories.

What distinguishes World Weidner is its authorized-dealer status for machine lines, which ensures factory-trained support and warranty service, combined with a family-run approach that emphasizes hands-on guidance. The company positions itself as a single source for both equipment and the consumables that keep it running.

name: Worldpac Inc
old_description: imports original equipment and automotive replacement parts directly from the most respected manufacturers in the industry. Our complete product offering includes over 110,000 products for over 40 import and domestic vehicle carlines.
about:
Worldpac Inc, headquartered in Woodlawn, Maryland, has been serving professional independent automotive service centers since 1969. The company operates as a wholesale distributor of original equipment (OE) automotive replacement parts, importing directly from manufacturers rather than producing its own components. No founders are named in public records, and ownership details such as family or veteran status are not disclosed.

Worldpac’s catalog encompasses more than 110,000 stocked products (over 120,000 by some counts) covering 41-plus vehicle carlines and 11 million-plus applications. Its proprietary speedDIAL online platform provides real-time availability, pricing, detailed images, and self-service ordering and returns for independent shops. Beyond parts distribution, the company offers carline-specific technical training, business management programs (branded Smart Groups), and turnkey marketing solutions designed to help shop owners focus on operations. Private-label brands include WORLD SOURCEONE AGM batteries, World Brake Resources brake pads, and METRIX climate-control components.

The primary customers are independent automotive repair facilities across North America, ranging from single-bay shops to multi-location operations. Worldpac positions itself as a partner that delivers the same breadth of OE parts and technical support traditionally available only to franchised dealers, enabling independents to service a wide mix of import and domestic vehicles.

Worldpac emphasizes its direct-from-manufacturer sourcing model and the depth of its digital catalog as key differentiators, claiming the largest import and domestic selection in North America and the industry’s most widely used electronic ordering system. The company was founded to give independent service centers dealer-level parts access and operational tools without requiring franchise affiliation.
